title: The Bell of the Ninth Gate
setting_summary: A walled city of seven tiers, each gated by a bell that rings only when the council permits passage. Water is rationed by the Bell-Keeper's ledger, and every spoken word in the lower tiers is recorded by listeners hidden in the stone. When the ninth bell—silent for a generation—begins to hum on its own, five lives are drawn into a trial of thresholds, bans, and the quiet arithmetic of mercy.
